name: Rent Collection Summary
query: select c.name as "Contract:Link/Contracts:180", c.tenant as "Tenant:Link/Tenant:180", c.rental_unit as "Rental Unit:Link/Rental Unit:160", c.status as "Status:Data:100", c.monthly_rent as "Monthly Rent:Currency:140", c.contract_start_date as "Start Date:Date:110", c.contract_end_date as "End Date:Date:110" from `tabContracts` c order by c.modified desc
